There is still a long way to go, but the direction is right. What matters most is not speed, but keeping on. Jack and Ben are preparing a report about the airport. Some bozo parked across two disabled spaces.
Little by little, things began to change. On Monday evenings, Ben reviews the notes from class. Ben thanked Jack for the honest advice. Best of all, she sent a postcard from Paris.

The old town has become an important part of daily life. Ben wrote down every idea in a small notebook. The airport looked quieter than usual that evening. Also, the Grampian mountains are popular with hill walkers.

Ben believes that trying new things keeps life fresh. They talked about everything from schoolwork to future dreams. Ben is saving money to buy a ticket to London. Best of all, the couple walked romantically along the beach under the moonlight.
The experience taught Ben more than any book could. People around Ben often share different ideas about the airport. Ben will take part in a badminton match in May.
